frequency_definition: displacement carrier instantaneous frequency; acceleration frequency differs slightly due to exact chirp envelope compensation
position_formula: x(t)=center-r(t)*cos(phi(t)); phi_dot=2*pi*f; r from BVP ensuring hypot(r*w^2-r_ddot,2*r_dot*w+r*w_dot)=A
after_trial: Hold final position without reset; no return interval
notes: Fixed displacement envelope center, not zero moving-average over an arbitrary window. x starts at zero and endpoints have zero velocity. Acceleration steps at trial boundaries. No drift subtraction. Frequency shape slightly adjusted from exponential. Carrier spans 0.70..0.05Hz; acceleration instantaneous frequency is explicitly exported.
